topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my college application essay featured on the school’s admissions blog this afternoon. It was unexpected, to say the least, but not unwelcome. My words, which I had poured my heart into, were now a guide for others navigating the same path. It’s a small honor, really, to know that my experience might help someone else express theirs. The essay was a reflection of where I was at that time, and seeing it now, I can appreciate how far I’ve come. What matters is that it serves its purpose, both then and now.
